# Summary and plot of cars dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
summary(cars)
```
what columns does `cars` have?
```{r}
colnames(cars)
```

```{r}
ggplot(cars, aes(x=speed, y=dist)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method="lm") +
  ggpubr::stat_cor() +
  ylab("stopping distance (ft)") +
  xlab("speed (mph)") +
  ggtitle("Correlation between speed and stopping distance of cars") +
  theme_classic()
```
